https://mastodon.social/@fkftsh@fkft.sh/.text: i keep seeing comparisons between w40k and starship troopers, but i don't think that works at all. starship troopers was a deliberate mockery of its source material, which was unapologetically fascist. none of the w40k games i've played have anything but reverence for their source material. they play the setting completely straight. there's no hidden undercurrent of mockery if you unpack their storylines. at best you get the subtext of "yeah, this is bad" in the setting itself. #games #gaming

https://mastodon.social/@fkftsh@fkft.sh/.name: FKFTSH
https://mastodon.social/@fkftsh@fkft.sh/.text: and mind you, i'm not trying to "cancel" w40k. i enjoy the games. they're fun. and they *are* cool. and i think that's exactly why we need to actively criticize the setting and the media. i think when we sit back and accept everything that w40k does without criticism, we let the satire become an excuse. the ridiculousness and the discomfort of engaging with media that - satirically or not - glorifies fascism needs to be something we're always, actively thinking about. #games #gaming

https://mastodon.social/@fkftsh@fkft.sh/.name: FKFTSH
https://mastodon.social/@fkftsh@fkft.sh/.text: sure, every w40k game plays up the hopelessness of the situation and how the imperium's efforts are not just in vain but actively make things worse - but that in and of itself contributes to the fascist fantasy. fascism is an ideology of death. fascists love nothing more than to fantasize about destroying themselves and everything around them as a blood offering to hate. #games #gaming

https://mastodon.social/@fkftsh@fkft.sh/.name: FKFTSH
https://mastodon.social/@fkftsh@fkft.sh/.text: the thing with w40k being satire is that at this point, w40k is satire in the same way that 4chan bigotry is ironic. the satire is an excuse. it lets you do what you want to do full-throatedly, and when your actions are questioned (or when you questioned them yourself), you can just say, "ah, but it's all *satire*". but when you're mowing down hordes of xenos in space marine 2, are you engaging with it as satire? or are you engaging with it as a badass space fascism simulator? #games #gaming

https://mastodon.social/@argv_minus_one@.text: The final map of #Doom 2 In Rural Only has 2897 sectors, 8039 things, 4223~5099 monsters, and 32014 vertices, most of which are visible at the same time because it's one not-really-subdivided big open outdoor space! You know what the most demanding map in vanilla Doom 2 is? MAP29: 205 sectors, 276 things, 1180 vertices, and 106 monsters. That's hundred, not thousand. And even those aren't all visible at the same blasted time. My #CPU is begging for mercy here. #gaming #retrogaming

https://mastodon.social/@argv_minus_one@.name: argv[-1]
https://mastodon.social/@argv_minus_one@.text: Dear #Doom mappers, This is Doom. It does not have level-of-detail. It does not have distance culling. If you make a huge map with a million sectors all joined together, the engine draws ALL of them at the same time. I should not get 10 frames/second playing f***ing Doom on a f***ing Ryzen. I know we don't have a visplane limit any more but JFC. What PC are you all testing these maps on?? Please, for the love of Oremor, divide up your maps with walls or something jeez. #gaming #retrogaming
